log_level.description: The logging verbosity level (e.g., DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

log_file.description: Path to the log file; empty string disables file logging

state_path.description: Directory path where the agent stores its runtime state (e.g., PID files, lock files)

bgp_router_id.description: The BGP router ID (must be a valid IPv4 address); typically the node's management IP

keepalive_interval.description: Time in seconds between BGP keepalive messages

hold_interval.description: BGP hold time in seconds (must be ≥ keepalive_interval × 3)

min_hold_time.description: Minimum acceptable hold time from peers (in seconds)

max_routes.description: Maximum number of BGP routes to store and advertise

md5_auth.description: Enable MD5 authentication for all BGP sessions

md5_key_file.description: Path to the shared MD5 key file (if md5_auth is enabled)

name.description: Unique identifier for this BGP neighbor (e.g., 'peer1')

ip_address.description: IP address of the BGP peer (must be reachable)

remote_as.description: Autonomous System (AS) number of the peer

password.description: MD5 password for this peer (if empty, uses global key or none)
